start.speaker: Fairy
start.text: Looking is free, precious. An oversight I intend to correct.

start.speaker: Customer
start.text: I want more than anyone else.

start.speaker: Fairy
start.text: Alrighty then. Would you like to finish “overcompensating for…” on top, or shall we let people guess?

good_result.speaker: Fairy
good_result.text: When you own the whole village, keep me in mind. I could use a landlord who owes me a favor.

bad_result.speaker: Fairy
bad_result.text: Seems wanting something and not getting it might do you more good than the cake.
